not_modelled.what: Retirement income exclusion for a person under 62 who is permanently disabled and unable to perform any gainful employment: up to 35,000 of the same retirement income as the 62-64 branch.

Additional military retirement exclusion of 17,500 (35,000 in all) for a person under 62 with more than 17,500 of Georgia earned income; the test is on the person's own earned income, which no projection measure holds.
Dependent exemption of 4,000 for each dependent, unborn dependents included.
Interest and dividends on U.S. Government bonds and other U.S. obligations are subtracted (Subtractions item 4).

approximations.what: Military retirement at 62 or older is left out of the general retirement exclusion (covers_unclear: the worksheet's 'Taxable Pensions' line does not say whether it includes military retirement).
approximations.size: 5.19% of the military retirement, up to the unused exclusion room, for a military retiree 62 or older.

approximations.what: The 5,000 earned-income limit inside the retirement exclusion is one combined limit on wages and other earned income; the projection applies 5,000 to wages and 5,000 to self-employment separately.
approximations.size: Only for a person 62 or older with both wages and self-employment income: at most 5.19% of 5,000 = 259.50 a year.

approximations.what: The Georgia standard deduction is always taken; a filer who itemizes federally must itemize for Georgia instead, and Georgia itemized deductions are not modelled.
approximations.size: 5.19% of the difference between Georgia itemized deductions and the standard deduction.

approximations.what: Interest on U.S. Treasury obligations is taxed (the projection cannot tell it from other interest).
A projection that cannot tell Georgia bonds from other states' bonds treats all tax-exempt interest as other-state and adds it back.
approximations.size: 5.19% of the interest from Georgia obligations.

approximations.what: Lump sum distributions from employee benefit plans reported on federal Form 4972 must be added to Georgia income (Additions item 3); the projection does not add them.
approximations.size: 5.19% of a Form 4972 lump sum, in the year taken.

approximations.what: The Low Income Credit (federal AGI less than 20,000) is out of the record's scope and not applied.
approximations.size: Small, for a household with federal AGI under 20,000.
